story_theme_en: Mali and her friends made a big banana cake in class. The teacher cut the cake into 4 equal slices. Mali ate 1 slice. Fractions help us talk about parts of a whole.
helper_tip_en: Read the problem carefully. Circle the important numbers. Then figure out what the question is asking.
think_story_en: We have 1 rows and 4 in each row. Use 1 x 4 = 4 slices.
explanation_steps_en: A fraction shows part of a whole.
The denominator tells how many equal parts the whole is split into.
The numerator tells how many of those parts we have.
Read the fraction as 'numerator over denominator'.
Use pictures to see fractions clearly.

worked_examples_en.question_en: A pizza was cut into 8 slices. Tom ate 3 slices. What fraction did Tom eat?
worked_examples_en.solution_en: 3 out of 8 equal slices = 3/8 3/8 of the pizza

hints_en: Read the problem twice before answering.

key_vocabulary.definition_en: A number that shows part of a whole
The top number - how many parts we have
The bottom number - how many equal parts the whole is divided into
All the parts together - the complete thing

key_vocabulary.th: ส่วนเท่าๆ กัน
key_vocabulary.definition_en: Parts that are the same size
A piece of something cut from the whole

test_bank_en.q: A pizza was cut into 8 equal slices. Mai ate 2 slices. What fraction did Mai eat?
A cake was cut into 6 equal pieces. Tom ate 1 piece. What fraction did Tom eat?
A bar of chocolate was broken into 4 equal parts. Lin ate 3 parts. What fraction did Lin eat?
A watermelon was cut into 10 equal slices. 7 slices were eaten. What fraction was eaten?
A cookie was cut into 3 equal pieces. Ai ate 2 pieces. What fraction did Ai eat?
A ribbon was 100 cm long. 75 cm was cut off. What fraction was cut?
A garden has 4 equal sections. 1 section has flowers. What fraction has flowers?
An orange was divided into 5 equal parts. 3 parts were eaten. What fraction was eaten?
A stick was broken into 8 equal pieces. 5 pieces were used. What fraction was used?
A rectangle was divided into 2 equal halves. 1 half was painted. What fraction was painted?

explanation_en: To solve this problem, identify the key numbers, choose the right operation, calculate carefully, and always check your answer. Remember to include the correct unit.
